description: Ingest pipeline for CPU metrics. Validates utilisation range and derives thermal warning.

script.source: if (ctx.cpu?.total_utilisation_pct != null && (ctx.cpu.total_utilisation_pct < 0 || ctx.cpu.total_utilisation_pct > 100)) { throw new Exception('cpu.total_utilisation_pct must be 0-100'); }

script.description: Derive CPU thermal warning when temperature exceeds 90C
script.source: if (ctx.cpu?.temperature_c != null) { ctx.cpu.thermal_warning = ctx.cpu.temperature_c > 90.0; } else { ctx.cpu.thermal_warning = false; }
